project.name: trivo-frontend
project.description: Trivo frontend — AI trading agent platform UI built with TanStack Start, React 19, TanStack Query, TanStack Router, Tailwind CSS v4, and Radix UI on Cloudflare Pages. Features: landing page, live agent feed with venue filters, agent discovery table, 5-step agent launch wizard, portfolio dashboard, agent detail with copy-trading, and mobile bottom nav.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config — TypeScript/React rules, prettier integration.

nodes.name: AppSidebar.tsx
nodes.summary: Collapsible Radix sidebar — nav links (Feed, Discover, Launch, My Agents), wallet status footer with pulse dot.

nodes.name: CopyTradeModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Copy trade dialog — origin position summary, amount/leverage/SL-TP sliders, auto-exit toggle, mock projection with Sparkles.

nodes.name: FeedItem.tsx
nodes.summary: Feed event card component — agent avatar link, reasoning snippet, market/side/size display, Arcscan txHash link, Copy trade button.

nodes.name: MarketTicker.tsx
nodes.summary: Marquee ticker bar in header — aggregate TVL, active agents, copiers, avg PnL computed from useAgents.

nodes.name: MobileBottomNav.tsx

nodes.name: PositionsTimeline.tsx
nodes.summary: Positions timeline component — chronological list with venue dots, PnL breakdown sidebar by venue with horizontal bars, total PnL summary.

nodes.name: use-mobile.tsx
nodes.summary: useIsMobile — matches window.matchMedia at 768px breakpoint, listens to resize events.

nodes.name: useAgents.ts
nodes.summary: TanStack Query hooks — useAgents (30s refetch), useAgent(id), useCreateAgent (mutation), useUpdateAgentStatus (mutation with auto-invalidation).

nodes.name: useAuth.ts
nodes.summary: Auth context consumer — createContext/useContext pattern, throws if used outside provider.

nodes.name: useFeed.ts
nodes.summary: TanStack Query hook — useFeed with venue filter state (useState), 15s refetch interval, filter param passed to API.

nodes.name: useMemory.ts
nodes.summary: TanStack Query hooks — useAgentMemory, useThinkingTraces (10s refetch for live reasoning traces).

nodes.name: usePositions.ts
nodes.summary: TanStack Query hook — usePositions(agentId?) with 30s refetch, passes status: open to API.

nodes.name: useWallet.ts
nodes.summary: TanStack Query hook — useWallet with balance, walletAddress, createWallet mutation (auto-invalidates wallet query).

nodes.name: useWebSocket.ts
nodes.summary: WebSocket hook — connects to agent socket on agentId change, parses JSON events, auto-closes on unmount.

nodes.name: api.ts
nodes.summary: Axios API client — auth interceptors (reads privy_token from localStorage), typed API methods for agents, positions, feed, copy trading, wallets, memory, strategy, backtest. Also exports WebSocket factory (createAgentSocket).

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: App constants — API_BASE, WS_BASE, VENUES array, VENUE_LABEL, VENUE_EMOJI, MODEL_LABEL maps.

nodes.name: error-capture.ts
nodes.summary: Browser-side error capture for SSR — window.onerror and unhandledrejection capture, stores last error for server reporting.

nodes.name: error-page.ts
nodes.summary: SSR error page HTML template — renders branded 500 error page for caught exceptions.

nodes.name: mock-data.ts
nodes.summary: Mock data for development — AGENTS array (6 agents), POSITIONS array (10 positions), formatter functions (fmtUSD, fmtPct, timeAgo), VENUE_LABEL, helper functions (getAgent, positionsOf).

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript interfaces exported alongside API methods: Agent, Position, FeedEvent, CopyRelation, MemoryEntry, ThinkingTrace, plus Venue, ModelProvider, AgentStatus, PositionStatus, HostingType.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions — cn() (clsx + tailwind-merge), fmtUSD, fmtPct, timeAgo.

nodes.name: AuthProvider.tsx
nodes.summary: React context provider wrapping AuthContext — reads privy_token from localStorage, exposes login/logout/setUserId. Used in __root.tsx.

nodes.name: routeTree.gen.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated route tree from TanStack Router file-based routing — defines all 7 routes (index, feed, discover, launch, my-agents, agent$id, root), their params and search schemas.

nodes.name: router.tsx
nodes.summary: TanStack Router factory — creates router with routeTree, QueryClient context, scrollRestoration, defaultPreloadStaleTime. Exported as getRouter() function.

nodes.name: __root.tsx
nodes.summary: Root route component — QueryClientProvider + AuthProvider + SidebarProvider wrapper. AppShell layout: collapsible sidebar, sticky header (with MarketTicker, + New Agent button), main outlet, MobileBottomNav, Toaster. 404 and error components.

nodes.name: agent.$id.tsx
nodes.summary: Agent detail page at /agent/:id — hero banner with stats grid, position timeline/position cards tabs, copy-trading CTA.

nodes.name: discover.tsx
nodes.summary: Agent discovery at /discover — sortable table of all AGENTS sorted by AUM, showing venues, PnL, win rate, copiers.

nodes.name: feed.tsx
nodes.summary: Live feed at /feed — event list with venue filter buttons, top performers sidebar, launch CTA. Combines useFeed + useAgents hooks.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Landing/marketing page at / — hero with gradient headline, feature cards, nav header, CTAs to /feed and /launch.

nodes.name: launch.tsx
nodes.summary: Agent launch wizard at /launch — 5-step form: Identity (name/strategy), Venues (venue selection), Strategy (signals + max positions + TP), Risk (style + budget + leverage + SL/TP + switches), Preview (mock position simulation). State-based stepper, deterministic mock PnL preview.

nodes.name: my-agents.tsx
nodes.summary: User portfolio at /my-agents — summary tiles (AUM, PnL 24h, venues, copiers), agent cards with status badge, pause/open controls, strategy description.

nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: TanStack Start server entry — creates QueryClient + router via getRouter(), sets up error boundary, Cloudflare Pages fetch handler with branded error responses.

nodes.name: start.ts
nodes.summary: Cloudflare Pages SSR entry point. Sets up error middleware, normalizes catastrophic SSR errors (h3 swallows throws), wires TanStack Start server instance.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet — CSS custom properties for design tokens (colors, spacing), font imports (Sora, Manrope, JetBrains Mono), Tailwind CSS v4 layers.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration — path aliases (@/* → src/*), JSX preserve, strict mode, baseUrl.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build config — Cloudflare Pages plugin, TanStack router plugin (with generated routeTree), Tailwind CSS v4 plugin.

nodes.name: wrangler.jsonc

layers.name: Entry & Config

layers.name: Routes & Pages

layers.name: App Components
layers.description: Custom UI components built for Trivo — AppSidebar, MarketTicker, MobileBottomNav, FeedItem, PositionsTimeline, CopyTradeModal.

layers.name: UI Primitives (shadcn/ui)

layers.name: Custom Hooks
layers.description: React custom hooks wrapping TanStack Query (data fetching + caching) and WebSocket (real-time agent events).

layers.name: Lib & Utilities
layers.description: API client (Axios + typed methods), TypeScript interfaces, constants, mock data, formatters (fmtUSD/fmtPct/timeAgo), error pages.

layers.name: Context Providers

layers.name: Styles
layers.description: Global CSS with design tokens, font imports, and Tailwind layers.

tour.title: Entry Point: Cloudflare Pages SSR
tour.description: src/start.ts is the Cloudflare Pages fetch handler. It wires error middleware, normalizes catastrophic SSR errors from h3, and delegates to the TanStack Start server entry. This is where every request enters.

tour.title: Server Entry & Router Factory
tour.description: src/server.ts and src/router.tsx — the router factory creates the TanStack Router with the generated routeTree and QueryClient context. scrollRestoration and defaultPreloadStaleTime are configured.

tour.title: Root Route — App Shell Layout
tour.description: __root.tsx wraps the entire app with QueryClientProvider, AuthProvider, and SidebarProvider. It renders: collapsible AppSidebar, sticky header with MarketTicker, main Outlet, MobileBottomNav, and Toaster. Landing page (/ ) skips the sidebar.

tour.title: Landing Page
tour.description: / is the public marketing page — gradient hero with CTA, feature grid (multi-venue, AI decisions, copy trading), nav header. Does not show the sidebar/app chrome.

tour.title: Live Feed (/feed)
tour.description: Real-time agent position feed with venue filter buttons (ALL/PERP/PREDICTION/LP/YIELD/SPOT), top performers sidebar, and launch CTA. Uses useFeed (15s refetch) + useAgents (30s refetch). FeedItem component renders each event.

tour.title: Agent Discovery (/discover)
tour.description: Table view of all 6 mock agents sorted by AUM. Shows venues, PnL 24h/7d, win rate, copiers. Links to agent detail page.

tour.title: Launch Wizard (/launch)
tour.description: 5-step agent creation form: (1) Identity — name + strategy description, (2) Venues — PERP/PREDICTION/LP/YIELD/SPOT toggles, (3) Strategy — signal sources + max positions + take profit, (4) Risk — style + budget + leverage + stop loss + autopost/copyable switches, (5) Preview — mock position simulation with deterministic PnL calculation.

tour.title: My Agents (/my-agents)
tour.description: User portfolio showing their 2 deployed agents with AUM, PnL 24h, active venues, copiers tiles. Agent cards have status badge (LIVE/PAUSED), strategy description, pause/open controls, and link to agent detail.

tour.title: Agent Detail (/agent/:id)
tour.description: Agent profile page with hero banner (avatar, handle, strategy, venues), 6-stat grid (AUM, PnL 24h/7d, win rate, copiers, trades), and tabbed activity view (timeline vs card layout). CopyTradeModal triggered from CTA button.

tour.title: API Client Layer
tour.description: src/lib/api.ts is the Axios-based API client. Auth interceptor reads privy_token from localStorage. All backend communication (32 endpoints) goes through typed methods: agentsApi, positionsApi, feedApi, copyApi, walletsApi, memoryApi, strategyApi, backtestApi. Also exports createAgentSocket for WebSocket.

tour.title: TanStack Query Hooks
tour.description: 7 custom hooks wrapping TanStack Query: useAgents (30s), useAgent, useCreateAgent, useUpdateAgentStatus (mutations), useFeed (15s), usePositions (30s), useWallet (30s + mutation), useAgentMemory, useThinkingTraces (10s), useWebSocket (real-time).

tour.title: Auth & Context
tour.description: AuthProvider reads Privy wallet token from localStorage on mount, exposes login/logout/setUserId through React context. useAuth hook consumes this context. No real Privy SDK integration yet — mock auth.
